title: ROSY Release Manifest
description: The contract shared by the SD image and the release bundle. Both carry this manifest and the same ARM64 container digests, so a device can decide whether an artifact is installable before unpacking any payload. This file is the declarative statement of the contract; deploy/robot/pinky_pro/release/manifest.py is the enforcing implementation, and test_release_manifest.py holds the two to the same required fields.

schema_version.description: Version of this manifest contract. A device rejects a version it does not implement rather than guessing.

release_id.description: Human-readable identifier, YYYY.MM.DD-NNN. Never the basis of a security decision — that is git_revision, the digests and the signature.

git_revision.description: Full 40-hex commit the release was built from. Abbreviated revisions are rejected: they are ambiguous.

created_at.description: Build timestamp, RFC 3339 with an explicit UTC offset.

target.description: The hardware and OS this release is installable on. A mismatch is refused before install.

runtime.description: Schema generations this release reads. A device refuses config or data it cannot interpret.

containers.description: Immutable OCI image digests. rosy_io is one image shared by the rosy-motor and rosy-io compose services; there is no separate rosy-motor artifact.

defaults.description: First-boot defaults. runtime_mode is core: first boot, update and rollback all come up core-only, and motor or hardware is a separate field approval.

signing_key_id.description: Identifies the public key under /etc/rosy/trusted-release-keys/. v1 trusts exactly one key; rotation happens through a new recovery image.

requires_recommissioning.description: Whether the device must be re-approved for motor or hardware mode after this release activates.

files.description: Payload files, each with its own checksum. Paths are relative and confined to the bundle root.
